concerns.text: FR-001 specifies a target N ≥ 1000, but T012 hardcodes a sampling cap at 10,000 and T016b only enforces a minimum of 500 with an INFO log for 500-999. There is no task explicitly implementing the logic to enforce the N ≥ 1000 target or to fail if the dataset falls between 500 and 1000, leaving the FR-001 target unverified.

SC-002 requires a statistical test (p < 0.05) comparing the model's CV performance against a null model. T024a implements a one-sample t-test comparing 5 fold-scores against a single scalar null RMSE. This is a statistical mismatch (distribution vs. constant) and no task exists that correctly implements the required two-sample or mean-comparison test to satisfy SC-002.

FR-005 and SC-003 require a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds to report RMSE variance (for regression) or F1 stability. T031 implements a threshold sweep but exclusively for a binary classification F1-sweep, ignoring the continuous RMSE variance requirement for the primary regression model defined in FR-005.

SC-003 defines success as 'RMSE varies by a negligible margin' or 'F1 varies by <10%'. T031 calculates the Coefficient of Variation (CV = std/mean) and compares it to 0.10. There is no task explicitly mapping the CV metric to the 'varies by <10%' criterion or calculating the direct variance margin required by the spec.

SC-004 requires permutation importance with p < 0.05. T028 computes permutation importance and p-values, but T029a (Collinearity/Retrain) is a blocking prerequisite that is currently marked as incomplete/failed in the task list. No task exists to handle the scenario where T029a fails or to ensure the stable model is available for T028, creating a coverage gap for SC-004 execution.

T041 is listed in 'Phase O: Revision & Gap Resolution' to 'verify' the null-model statistical test, but T024a already defines the implementation. This suggests a stale or redundant task tag that does not correspond to a distinct spec requirement, potentially confusing the implementation scope.
